architecture: GRU(14,32), Linear(32,3), zero-initialized output; scene is batch item and hidden reset per scene
smoothing: lambda * mean(second difference of clipped delta squared), only triples of consecutive ready 10ms events in same scene
normalizer: per-fold channel mean/std from that fold's 18 training scenes only, all 1999 causal input events
important_limit: This is TRAIN24 wind-group CV for a residual head only. The frozen C5 backbone has already seen more data; this is not independent full-system validation and is not closed-loop evidence.
